protocol: class-agnostic multi-granularity masks from the released interactive predictor with an ORACLE point at the ground-truth box center; per-expression oracle best-of-6 mask IoU (upper bound) and predicted-IoU-selected mask IoU (text-free lower bound). This is a component/mask-ceiling measurement, not a referring-method comparison.
env: conda semantic-sam: Python 3.10, torch 2.2.1+cu121, detectron2 (official), MultiScaleDeformableAttention, kornia 0.6.4
